questions.question: Clarify Pacioli’s birth date, early biography and teaching career.

localizations.source: Clarify Pacioli’s birth date, early biography and teaching career.
localizations.ru: Уточнить дату рождения, раннюю биографию и преподавательскую деятельность Пачоли.

questions.resolution: The birth date is presented as approximate; the early biography and teaching career omit unverified details.

questions.question: Remove absolute claims about the completeness of the *Summa* and adoption of Hindu-Arabic numerals; check the algebraic abbreviations.

localizations.source: Remove absolute claims about the completeness of the *Summa* and adoption of Hindu-Arabic numerals; check the algebraic abbreviations.
localizations.ru: Снять абсолютные обобщения о полноте «Суммы» и принятии индийско-арабских цифр; проверить примеры алгебраических сокращений.

questions.resolution: The generalizations were qualified; the supported co, ce and cu abbreviations remain, while the doubtful root notation was removed.
